step_3_family_and_relatives.name: Seyievinuo Angami
step_3_family_and_relatives.notes: Lives in Kohima with me; high school principal; takes me on daily walks and coordinates doctor visits.

step_3_family_and_relatives.name: Neiphrelie Angami
step_3_family_and_relatives.notes: Married 48 years; master weaver of traditional Angami shawls (Loramhü); cooks traditional smoked meat stew.

step_3_family_and_relatives.name: Kevilezo Angami
step_3_family_and_relatives.notes: Lives in Dimapur; works in Agriculture Directorate; visits every second weekend with farm produce.

step_3_family_and_relatives.name: Vimenuo Angami
step_3_family_and_relatives.notes: Granddaughter; loves listening to grandfather recount Angami warrior folk legends and forest tales.

step_3_family_and_relatives.name: Vitsore Angami
step_3_family_and_relatives.notes: Younger brother; village elder in Khonoma; visits Kohima monthly to talk about village council matters.

step_4_life_story_and_interests.occupation: Retired District Agriculture Officer & Angami Folklore Custodian
step_4_life_story_and_interests.favorite_music_or_artists: Traditional Naga folk chants (Li), choral Christian hymns, acoustic guitar melodies.
step_4_life_story_and_interests.cultural_background: Angami Naga community; celebrates Sekrenyi purification festival and Hornbill Festival; wears traditional red-black woven shawl.
step_4_life_story_and_interests.what_brings_them_joy: Tending his terrace vegetable garden in Midland, looking at carved wooden Hornbill artefacts, and telling tribal stories to his granddaughter.

step_5_and_6_familiar_places.short_description: Where we live — hillside family home with terrace vegetable garden and pine trees.
Local organic market where we buy fresh mountain herbs, king chillies, and wild honey.

step_5_and_6_familiar_places.place_name: Mary Help of Christians Cathedral Kohima
step_5_and_6_familiar_places.short_description: Place of worship — landmark cathedral on Aradurah Hill overlooking Kohima town.
Where I get monthly health assessments and cognitive support therapy.
Where we walk — serene terraced garden with blooming roses and peaceful stone paths.
